text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
"That was so close...
The crane game is a formidable foe..."

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
No, there is no need for an apology.
Your thoughts alone are more than enough, Trainer-dono.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: ...May everyone be protected by someone kind-hearted...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: It ended in a disappointing result...
